title: LLM Price Changes 2026: 18 Weekly Snapshots, One Pattern
description: We checked up to 60 LLM APIs weekly for 130 days. Listed model IDs changed price 10 times in 814 checks; since August, every list-price cut came as a new model.

attribution.citation: Json House, "LLM Price Changes 2026: 18 Weekly Snapshots, One Pattern", jsonhouse.com (2026-11-23)

key_facts.fact: Across 18 weekly snapshots of six providers' official pricing pages from 2026-07-16 to 2026-11-23 (130 days), models that stayed listed changed price in 10 of 814 week-to-week checks (1.2%): 7 cuts and 3 increases, on 9 models
key_facts.source: jsonhouse original measurement from weekly snapshots 2026-07-16 to 2026-11-23

key_facts.fact: 24 of the 29 models listed in all 18 snapshots ended on 2026-11-23 at exactly their 2026-07-16 input, output and cache-read price; 4 ended lower (three OpenAI GPT-5.6 models and Grok 4.5's cache read) and 1 higher (DeepSeek v4-pro)
key_facts.source: jsonhouse original measurement from weekly snapshots 2026-07-16 to 2026-11-23

key_facts.fact: Between 2026-08-24 and 2026-11-23 no listed model had its input or output price cut except Mistral Large 4 reversing its own increase, while 8 new model IDs launched with an input price 20% to 90% below their predecessor's
key_facts.source: jsonhouse original measurement from weekly snapshots 2026-07-16 to 2026-11-23

key_facts.fact: Of 19 same-line successor models compared with their predecessor in the week they first appeared, 8 had a lower input price, 10 the same and 1 higher; the median input price change at launch was 0%
key_facts.source: jsonhouse original measurement from weekly snapshots 2026-07-16 to 2026-11-23

key_facts.fact: 10 of the 19 successors launched with a cheaper cache-read price, more than cut their input price; GPT-6.1-sol and Claude Fable 5.1 changed only the cache read
key_facts.source: jsonhouse original measurement from weekly snapshots 2026-07-16 to 2026-11-23

key_facts.fact: All three increases on listed models came from DeepSeek (v4-flash and v4-pro, between 2026-08-10 and 2026-08-17) and Mistral (Mistral Large 4, +100% between 2026-10-19 and 2026-10-26, then -48.5% on input by 2026-11-10)
key_facts.source: jsonhouse original measurement from weekly snapshots 2026-07-16 to 2026-11-23

key_facts.fact: The tracked set grew from 38 to 60 models through 32 entries and 10 exits; 8 of the entries came on 2026-07-28 when coverage widened, and 5 of the exits on 2026-08-17 were models already retired
key_facts.source: jsonhouse original measurement from weekly snapshots 2026-07-16 to 2026-11-23

key_facts.fact: Google's Gemini 4 Argon and Gemini 4 Carbon are scheduled to double from $2.00/$10.00 to $4.00/$20.00 per 1M tokens on 2026-12-01, and Gemini 3.8 Flash and 3.6 Flash from $0.75/$3.75 to $1.50/$7.50 on 2027-01-01

faq_summary.q: Do LLM API prices go down over time in 2026?
faq_summary.a: Not on the model you already use. 24 of the 29 models tracked from 2026-07-16 to 2026-11-23 ended at exactly their July price; since 2026-08-24 every input or output list-price cut came with a new model ID.

faq_summary.q: How often does an LLM API price change?
faq_summary.a: In 10 of 814 week-to-week checks of models that stayed listed, about 1.2%: seven cuts and three increases.

faq_summary.q: Is a new LLM model version cheaper than the one it replaces?
faq_summary.a: About half the time on input price: of 19 same-line successors, 8 were cheaper, 10 the same and 1 more expensive. 10 of 19 launched with a cheaper cache read.

faq_summary.q: Did any LLM API provider raise prices in 2026?
faq_summary.a: Yes, three times on listed models: DeepSeek v4-flash and v4-pro on 2026-08-17, and Mistral Large 4 on 2026-10-26, which fell back by half by 2026-11-10.

faq_summary.q: Which LLM API prices are scheduled to change next?
faq_summary.a: As published on 2026-11-23: GPT-5.6-sol's promotion ends 2026-11-30; Gemini 4 Argon and Carbon double on 2026-12-01; Gemini 3.8 and 3.6 Flash double on 2027-01-01.
